功能: 安装、官方版共存、APK 备份恢复与资源部署
入口: Outer installer MainActivity and explicit install/restore controls
默认设置: Device/profile-dependent install workflow; main APK identity/signature is fixed
实现: Outer LocalAdb implements normal RSA ADB authentication at controller loopback. RC2 bootstrap checks uid first, then conditionally sets the boot debug property and ADB TCP/restart properties and polls for root uid. It bundles the already-known A-031 Fuli utility, a secondary installer, Files helper and UI/media resources. It checks original/main APK hashes, offers original package removal keeping data, installs the supplied signed main package and seeds coexist/launcher resources.
写入或副作用: Android package/property/file changes and force-stop operations if the host permits them; no novel privilege-grant exploit established
确认: Package identity/hash and selected shell results; no actual install, successful root grant or device persistence observed in this review
恢复与生命周期: Original APK restore is not a full backup of app data, permissions, ADB/system settings or helper packages. RC Pro profile is specifically the inspected enterprise/rm510/SDK29 branch, not every RC Pro.
复用建议: Borrow explicit artifact identity and backup verification. Build our own narrow installer/rollback model; do not assume stock installer accepts a modified/re-signed main APK.

功能: RID Kill：云控拦截及 legacy DroneID / EID 周期请求
入口: S.ridKill/settings callback; UAVRidCloudControlLogic and BroadcastEffectCloudControlLogic connection/write hooks -> Rid.onConnect
默认设置: rid_kill defaults true, including preference access failure
实现: Guards suppress selected RID cloud subscription/write paths. A connected worker sends legacy DataFlycDetection SetSwitch with eight false entries twice, 250 ms apart, and requests EIDSwitch=false through the SDK, then schedules another cycle after 12 s. The first cycle issues before/after mask GETs but only logs them. Exact native EID owner remains the France EID command plane.
写入或副作用: Actual device SET candidates plus application cloud-path changes; this does not implement a standard BLE/Wi-Fi RID master switch
确认: Waits for callbacks but does not parse/enforce/save initial mask state; no EID independent GET. ACK is not device-applied/RF evidence.
恢复与生命周期: Disabling/disconnect removes queued cycles; it does not restore original mask/EID state, prove in-flight quiescence, or reconstruct every skipped subscription. The first-cycle marker is not reset on reconnect in the inspected class.
复用建议: Use as owner/call-path evidence and a demonstration of in-process hooks. Do not reuse its default-on loop, blanket disable or restore semantics for FindUAS.

功能: 遥控器 Android 定位开关
入口: gpskill.G and RcGps settings controls
默认设置: Manual control; saves Android restore_mode before changing location_mode
实现: Changes Settings.Secure location_mode through the host ContentResolver and checks Android provider/settings state. This controls the controller's location service, separately from aircraft FCGPSEnabled.
写入或副作用: Host Android location configuration
确认: Provider/readback polling up to 5 s with a settings fallback; no airplane GNSS, RID or radio proof
恢复与生命周期: Stores a local prior mode for restoration; success depends on Android permissions and platform behavior
复用建议: A separately labelled host-location control is useful. Do not conflate it with aircraft positioning or a RID location source.

功能: 飞机 GPS 开关与 RC2 兼容桥
入口: flyctl.F.writeGps and quick/custom button actions
默认设置: Manual action; quick state may be cached
实现: FCGPSEnabled SDK route is separate from host Android GPS. On non-rc331, NativeKeys.write waits for SET and performs up to three GET checks. The rc331 path also sends repeated parameter writes through a controller-local bridge and updates gpsLast before receiving any device confirmation.
写入或副作用: Aircraft GPS state change candidate; rc331 compatibility bridge is a separate transport path
确认: RC2 bridge sends do not await a matching ACK and exceptions can be swallowed; true/OK UI return does not prove the aircraft accepted the change
恢复与生命周期: No verified original-state journal or complete restore/RF chain; reconnect/reboot behavior untested
复用建议: Borrow SDK owner discovery and readback pattern. Rebuild one measured transport path with exact session binding; reject the unacknowledged bridge as a verified control.

功能: 飞行记录 UIMap / 轨迹 JSON 导出
入口: frtool.Decryptor file/folder chooser and parseFolder
默认设置: Manual; existing output filenames are skipped
实现: Reads Fly FlightRecord/MCDatFlightRecords candidates and invokes UavJNIFlightRecordUIMapConvertor nativeInit/parseWithFilePath then parserFrUIMapData. JSON/Base64 MapDetailData is decoded to a .decrypted.json trajectory/map representation with aircraft/home/user positions.
写入或副作用: Reads local log files and writes local JSON; no aircraft state change
确认: Native parser result codes 0/200/205 enter conversion. No real encrypted log was processed in this review; the prior schema check used synthetic data only.
恢复与生命周期: Output-exists skip can retain an older result. DAT suffix scanning is not proof DAT support; the module's help says DAT is unsupported.
复用建议: Useful for map/trajectory extraction in the fixed host after validating real input. It is not a complete raw flight-record decoder or TBIE/STUE firmware decryptor.

功能: FC 参数扫描、修改、DHP 备份和选择性恢复
入口: New Menu.page parameter page -> paramedit.Editor.entry
默认设置: Explicit scan/edit/export/import; KnownGroups names classify returned parameters only
实现: Discovers table metadata through E0/E1, reads values with E2, writes E3 through an independent DataBase subclass and the existing ServiceManager transport. verifiedWrite checks fresh metadata and expected-before value, writes, then independently E2-reads and compares. DHP export snapshots memory; restore matches by name with type/range/ambiguity checks and previews selected items.
写入或副作用: Actual aircraft parameter SET candidates when connection/flight/motor gates pass; copied metadata attribute=1 is not recovered write permission
确认: Per-write separate readback is present. Actual Mini 5 Pro support and each parameter effect are unobserved. Completeness flags cover discovered/accepted rows only.
恢复与生命周期: Export can combine old values with newly-read identity. Restore is not bound to the backup's original device; successful early writes persist if a later item fails. Cancel is not transport quiescence. No durable baseline/rollback for a write whose ACK succeeds but readback fails.
复用建议: Highest-value control pattern: metadata discovery, expected-before check and independent readback. Reimplement the transport adapter, epoch/identity fences, original-state journal and partial-result handling in our own code.

功能: 继承的 DJI Fly 主体与进程内 SDK 环境
入口: Manifest DJIApplication -> UAVApplication / UAVSDKManager; existing Fly activities/services
默认设置: Normal Fly application lifecycle, plus the separately inventoried mod providers/hooks
实现: The supplied APK retains Fly's existing aircraft connection, FPV/camera/media, flight-record/map, device-settings and mission-related code. Mod features reuse those views, model streams, DataBase ownership and native SDK rather than operating as a separate generic remote controller.
写入或副作用: Inherited host capabilities remain subject to original model/service/permission conditions; this row is a dependency summary, not certification of every official feature
确认: Package/class/manifest and selected call-chain evidence only. The review does not reimplement or exhaustively audit every inherited Fly algorithm or third-party library.
恢复与生命周期: Same-process initialized SDK, native libraries and current aircraft link are required. Copying wrapper classes into another Android process does not reproduce this state.
复用建议: Recommended foundation is our own small source module plus a version-bound host adapter. APK patching is a fixed-base experiment; whole-app decompiled-Java rebuilding is not a maintainable source fork.

功能: Smart RTH 开关
入口: flysettings.S.tabSafety / modsettings160.Menu → Guard.add → Settings.smartToggle；连接恢复、确认从飞行转为落地时同步 managed 设置
默认设置: rth_r1_smart: False；rth_r1_smart_managed: False；meaning: checked means disable Smart RTH; initial read can replace local flag with inverse aircraft state
实现: Guard.syncSmart → Sdk.fc(SmartBatteryRTHEnabled) → UAVKeyManager.t；apply 且当前值不同 → GET IsFlying → 仅 false 时 UAVKeyManager.x → 再 GET 比较；SDK 无 Boolean → RawSmart.probe；已验证 alias 才 RawSmart.write；参数元数据核对 + 三次 fresh readback
写入或副作用: Guard.syncSmart → Sdk.fc(SmartBatteryRTHEnabled) → UAVKeyManager.t；apply 且当前值不同 → GET IsFlying → 仅 false 时 UAVKeyManager.x → 再 GET 比较；SDK 无 Boolean → RawSmart.probe；已验证 alias 才 RawSmart.write；参数元数据核对 + 三次 fresh readback

复用建议: 可借鉴先读、单次写后再读、连接 epoch 与落地门禁；FindUAS 不能将此开关替代 RID 控制。应增加原值基线、身份绑定及电机状态要求。

功能: 按原因取消 RTH
入口: Guard.Settings 的 Experimental 开关；CountDownLandingInfo / GoHomeAssessment / CountDownInfo / DiveGoHomeCountDown 订阅；原 Fly 新旧倒计时通知 hooks
默认设置: all_missing_rth_r1_policy_flags: False；rth_r1_notify: True；policies: smart；warning；voltage；gps；sticks；complex；video；gps_restore；dive；fan
实现: Policy.countdown/reason → Guard.event / checkFlight；倒计时 → ConfirmLowBatteryAutoGoHome(false), StopDiveGoHome, CountDownAction(CANCEL), 或 CountDownLandingAction(CANCEL)；已 GO_HOME → 再读 AutoRTHReason → Policy.canStop → StopGoHome
写入或副作用: Policy.countdown/reason → Guard.event / checkFlight；倒计时 → ConfirmLowBatteryAutoGoHome(false), StopDiveGoHome, CountDownAction(CANCEL), 或 CountDownLandingAction(CANCEL)；已 GO_HOME → 再读 AutoRTHReason → Policy.canStop → StopGoHome
确认: 倒计时 callback 仅确认接受；随后 episode 消失会报告 request ended。StopGoHome ACK 明确等待 FlightMode 离开 GO_HOME；两次后仍 GO_HOME 会报告 active。
恢复与生命周期: 关闭策略只停止以后相应取消，不恢复已取消的返航或启动新返航。策略不改变永久故障阈值。
复用建议: 可借鉴原因分类、有限尝试和动作 ACK 与状态转换分离的状态机。用于 FindUAS 的 RID 状态机时必须换成该目标的独立 readback，不能迁移 RTH 语义。

功能: 飞机前后灯控制
入口: Q.ledToggle → F.bindLed；B CUSTOM102 → F.setLed

实现: Five supported owners: DataFlycGetPushGpsSnr, DataCameraGetPushChart, DataOsdGetPushConfig, DataSmartBatteryGetPushDynamicData and DataSmartBatteryGetPushCellVoltage. GPS SNR requests DataFlycSetPushGpsSnr.setEnable(true). Battery requests create a new model with index 0, requestPush=false and continuePush=true; those field names are not a proven wire semantic.
写入或副作用: GPS SNR starts an aircraft diagnostic push; no paired disable/restore was found in this class. Other supported models send their request via the existing DataBase transport.
确认: Waits for callbacks up to 6 s; SNR polls a packet snapshot for up to 3 s. No initial packet sequence/freshness baseline is captured, so an older packet can satisfy this check.
恢复与生命周期: A UI scan stop does not establish request quiescence. SNR enable is not tied to a durable original-state record or restoration on exit.
复用建议: Use only as a list of candidate SDK owners. Reimplement an explicit action contract and fresh-result correlation before adopting active requests.

功能: 遥测快照导出 CSV
入口: TelemetrySettings export -> TelemetryExport.capture -> Rc2Export
默认设置: Manual export
实现: Captures in-memory records from all items regardless of visible filtering, with no new reads. UTF-8 BOM, semicolon-separated, 27 columns including key identity/type, source, state/error, freshness, age and source time. Formula-leading text is protected unless parsed as a number. API>=29 uses MediaStore Downloads/RedFly/Telemetry with pending publication and incomplete-file deletion; older Android uses external Downloads.
写入或副作用: Writes a local user-selected export file; no aircraft SET
确认: File publication/stream completion only, not verification of underlying data freshness
恢复与生命周期: Point-in-time process snapshot; may contain coordinates or identifiers already collected. No automatic value redaction.
复用建议: High for evidence export after adding our redaction policy and clear session/source provenance.

功能: GNSS 实验室与遥控器/飞机定位视图
入口: modsettings160.TelemetrySettings.Page -> gnsslab.Page.entry; Page.Session.resume/acquirePage; manifest gnsslab.TestActivity wraps the same Page.Session and is exported with android.permission.DUMP required
默认设置: Entering the page acquires a collector lease; page mode requests SNR enable once per aircraft generation. HTTP /start alone does not automatically enable SNR/raw.
实现: Bridge listens to aircraft GPS/location/velocity/diagnostic keys and controller keys, observes Android GnssStatus and passive LocationManager updates with fine-location permission, and maintains separate aircraft/controller records. Page refreshes diagnostic states periodically. GnssModel assigns synthetic S+slot identifiers to aircraft SNR arrays (32/32/32/64 slots), separates the high-bit flag from raw&127 magnitude, and does not prove physical dB-Hz or satellite identity. Controller values come from Android C/N0 and constellation/carrier metadata.
写入或副作用: Page acquisition requests GPSSNRInfoPushEnable=true; other collected values are reads/listens. No coordinate setter is implemented here.
确认: Caches are unknown-age and not fresh; ordinary source ages use a 5 s display threshold. Listener age is time since value change, not guaranteed last packet reception. Android fix validation uses elapsed fix time; valid geographic range alone does not reject 0,0.
恢复与生命周期: Page leases, collection generation and aircraft generation guard work/callbacks; explicit disconnect clears aircraft records/raw data and invalidates refresh. External ownership or a manual switch request can keep collection running after page close.
复用建议: High for a GNSS diagnostic view, with explicit active-request consent in our UI and corrected restoration. Does not establish RID position source, spoofing, or RF control.

功能: GNSS 本地 HTTP、原始数据缓存与诊断开关
入口: Bridge.serve on 127.0.0.1:18776; GET /state, /raw; POST /start, /stop, /pushSNR, /rawEnable
默认设置: Starts with collector/page use; loopback only; no authentication token
实现: POST requires JSON body length 2..4096, bounded headers/line lengths, and a matching Origin if Origin is present. Missing Origin is accepted. Raw GNSS listener packets retain sequence, receipt time, length, truncation and overwrite counts; 32-packet ring, at most 20480 bytes per retained packet. Switches resolve exact SDK keys GPSSNRInfoPushEnable and CeInfoEnable, check canSet, then call UAVKeyManager.x through a single setter queue.
写入或副作用: Two actual device diagnostic SET candidates. Only an explicit disconnected Boolean blocks requests; unknown connection is not rejected. Worker reads previous value from SDK cache and marks ownership before ACK if previous is not true, including unknown.
确认: HTTP response is request_queued. Setter callbacks record ACK status and wait-for-data text; no independent switch GET/readback verifies the requested value.
恢复与生命周期: end invalidates generations, clears work/data/listeners and queues false for switches marked owned; it does not restore an unknown/previous value. Cleanup workers lack a connection-identity/generation check at dispatch. The HTTP server remains available until close. This is a potential cross-session cleanup issue, not an observed device event.
复用建议: Rebuild protocol and typed record format, adding authentication even on loopback, exact session binding, a fresh baseline, result correlation and restoration. Do not expose these switches as passive observation.

功能: GNSS 干扰/欺骗状态显示
入口: Bridge.ensureAircraft and refreshStates; HomeStatusListener EventBus subscription
默认设置: During collection; page-triggered refresh uses the same collector generations
实现: Requests SDK GPSSpoofingState and GPSInterferenceState and listens for diagnostic updates. HomeStatusListener accepts DataOsdGetPushHome payloads >=76 bytes; byte75 bits5..6 and bits3..4 are mapped by this mod to INVALID/OK/WARNING/CRITICAL, with native_code/raw-byte/length metadata. Refresh results are stored separately as SDK values and replace primary state only if no newer state event occurred.
写入或副作用: State GET/listen only, separate from SNR/raw enable controls
确认: Two asynchronous GET callbacks share a 6 s wait and request ID/session checks. Labels are the program's interpretation of SDK/packet data; no interference/spoofing experiment verified these semantics for Mini 5 Pro.
恢复与生命周期: Refresh ID and state-event version prevent late refresh from overwriting a newer event; disconnect invalidates the generation
复用建议: Useful diagnostic candidate with explicit source and raw status retained. Do not market it as a proven spoofing detector or use its OK label to certify GNSS integrity.

功能: Wi-Fi 局域网画面直播与浏览器观看
入口: SettingLiveStreamingAdvanceViewModel.R / SettingLiveStreamingTypeSelectRecyclerAdapter.onBindViewHolder -> LanUI tile and dialog -> Lan.start
默认设置: Initially IDLE; manual launch. UI dismissal does not stop the stream.
实现: LanHotspot obtains Android LocalOnlyHotspot and displays its generated SSID/password. LanEnc uses the existing Fly LiveStreamVideoEncoder and forwards H.264 access units. LanHttp listens on all interfaces 0.0.0.0:8080 with plaintext HTTP; framed stream has a 4-byte length plus flag byte. Browser page remuxes SPS/PPS/H.264 into fragmented MP4 for MSE, targets about 0.3 s buffer, and adjusts playback. Client queue holds 240 frames; overflow clears it and waits for the next keyframe.
写入或副作用: Local hotspot, encoder and HTTP server; no flight-control endpoint found in LanHttp
确认: Ready status comes from hotspot readiness. Encoder callbacks/feed counters are not proof a browser received or decoded a frame. No stream was executed in this review.
恢复与生命周期: Stop closes reservation, encoder, HTTP listener and clients; dialog dismissal only stops UI refresh. Server has no authentication/TLS; /stat includes status with hotspot credentials/IP, and /tel contains coordinates. The all-interface bind is not restricted to the newly created hotspot.
复用建议: Useful second-screen architecture. Rebuild a bounded, authenticated transport and lifecycle; keep coordinates/status access separate and prove actual decode before reporting ready.

功能: 直播页面的遥测叠加
入口: Lan.start -> LanTel.start; HTTP /tel and browser polling
默认设置: Static startup only once; browser polls about once per second
实现: Reflective FlyModelRx subscriptions collect battery percent, satellites, signal, 2D/3D position, velocity and distance. JSON exposes battery/satellites/signal, lat/lon/alt, distance and horizontal/vertical speed. Retry subscription attempts run at 8 s intervals up to 20 rounds.
写入或副作用: Reads/listens and exports data to local HTTP clients
确认: No per-value age/source/validity fields. Position/speed defaults include zero; unavailable battery/signal/distance use -1. Stale retained values can look current.
恢复与生命周期: Returned Rx disposables are not retained for cancellation, no LanTel.stop is implemented, and partial subscription retries can add a source again. Static values survive stream stop.
复用建议: Reuse display fields only after adding valid/unknown/stale state and owned subscriptions. This is aircraft-app telemetry, not an independent RID receiver.

功能: 当前五页设置与主页入口
入口: Fpv之外：DJIMainPageFragment.onCreateView → redfly.L.bind → homequick.Dashboard；Dashboard按钮或redfly-settings-link调用S.showSettings；UAVMeFragment.enterForum → S.showSettings；S.showSettings → modsettings160.Menu.show
默认设置: page: 0；tabs: General；Control；View；Telemetry；Advanced；page_cache: 一次dialog内惰性创建；重新打开回General
实现: Menu.page用反射复用tabBasic、modeSwitchCard、quickTogglesCard、gimbalPage、mapsCard；反射失败显示Unavailable。；General包含地区/FCC、RC定位、Smart Landing、HYBRID、更新设置与诊断上报入口；Control包含模式映射、快捷面板组成与默认展开；View包含全屏和waypoint lite；Telemetry包含GNSS/浏览器/档案/显示行；Advanced包含RTH guard、参数编辑器、校准、资源ZIP、地图迁移、日志与RID。；前两页拆成双列并按可用高度等比例缩小，其余页滚动。Dashboard依赖既有resource IDs及视图类型，将原搜索/飞前/推荐块隐藏，放入RC定位、Landing、设置与版本卡。
写入或副作用: 导航、视图结构和可见性；具体控制卡动作归其它专项结论，不能把整个菜单称只读。
确认: 打开菜单本身无确认；Calib.attach挂在dialog生命周期。
恢复与生命周期: 页面在本次dialog内缓存；Dashboard按layout重新定位并在detach移除layout监听。
复用建议: 可复用分组与状态语义；应重写硬编码ID、私有方法反射和按高度缩放触控尺寸。

功能: 独立浮动快捷按钮、面板与组成设置
入口: FpvComponentActivity.onResume → flyctl.Q.attach → QuickPanel.bind → FloatingQuick.bind；Control → legacy(quickTogglesCard) + Expand quick panel on entry
默认设置: qt_gps: True；qt_led: True；qt_atti: True；qt_atti_sport: False；qt_rc_gps: False；qt_tof_off: False；qt_vision: False；qt_vis: True
实现: Q.attach先挂Readouts与legacy overlays，再按mod_settings选择要创建的快捷开关；面板tag已存在时不重新构造。；FloatingQuick把显示/隐藏按钮与面板拖动手柄分开；点按钮仅切VISIBLE/GONE；DragHandle分别存quick_button与quick_block的x/y dp，并限制在父视图内。；触摸取消或新增手指会恢复本次拖动起点；未超过touch slop则performClick。；fpvextras.Settings.addQuick配置SPORT→ATTI、RC GPS、Smart Landing显示；Extras.addVisionChoice配置VPS显示。SL实际控制在连接、已读状态且非busy/reading时才可点击。
写入或副作用: 组成开关、默认展开、位置只改本地UI偏好；点击面板内GPS/LED/ATTI/RC GPS/SL/VPS是独立控制操作，按flight/system专项判断。
确认: 拖动/组成配置不另确认；临时点开/隐藏没有写qt_vis，下一次构造按偏好恢复。
恢复与生命周期: 组成通常需重新创建FPV面板才更新；位置持久化。新Readouts前置时也会前置快捷按钮。
复用建议: 可复用独立拖动、边界限制与取消回滚；把显示配置和设备控制动作在类型/API层明确分开。

功能: Clean FPV全屏与保留的触摸路径
入口: View → Enable full-screen mode / Show top bar；FpvComponentActivity.dispatchTouchEvent → Bridge.onFpvTouch；flyctl.B已分配控制器动作 → Bridge.toggleFullscreen
默认设置: cleanview_enabled: True；cleanview_full_video: False；show_top_bar: True；gesture: 新设置把入场开关统一到cleanview_enabled；旧double-tap偏好仅参与一次迁移
实现: 进入需单指、state_preview_big、主view_surface可见且覆盖至少半个内容面积，触点在视频内且未被可点击/长按/滚动控件遮挡；并排除遥测块和快捷面板触点。；Bridge用300ms/50dp判断双击进入；CleanView隐藏当前可见chrome，记录被隐藏视图。默认保留顶栏；full_video=true时也隐藏顶栏。；当前addCatcher创建modsettings160.InputCatcher。它把正常触摸经坐标换算转发到底层内容；双击退出先向已接收序列的目标发CANCEL，等UP/CANCEL后退出；Back也退出。；InputCatcher.keep保留zoom/focus和preview middle层；Readouts.front把自定义遥测层和快捷按钮置前，所以当前全屏可保留这些自定义控件。
写入或副作用: 只改窗口FLAG_FULLSCREEN、视图可见性、焦点与触摸分派；未见此功能改视频编码或飞行参数。
确认: 无二次确认；再次双击、Back或已分配按钮可退出。改cleanview_*偏好会重置手势并退出正在显示的全屏。
恢复与生命周期: 全屏活动状态为进程内弱引用/hiddenViews，不是跨重启状态；stop把本次隐藏的视图恢复VISIBLE并移除catcher。
复用建议: 触摸转发与双击取消序列值得参考；应使用明确生命周期与组件状态，减少对原布局层级和resource ID的依赖。

功能: 遥测显示行与新浮层
入口: Telemetry → Screen readouts / Add readout / 每行开关、设置、删除、拖动；Q.attach → Bridge.attach → Readouts.attach
默认设置: rows: cells；temperature；height；distance；traffic；all_five_enabled: False；max_rows: 64；new_row: enabled: True；multiplier: 1；maxCharacters: 4；intervalMs: 1000；stored_rows_key: telemetry_custom44/rows
实现: Presentation.init首次创建5个disabled Row；之后不覆盖已有rows/rows_initialized。；当前TelemetrySettings.Editor是名称、值、显示开关、›设置、删除和拖动手柄；旧内联表格列标题/InlineEdit残留不代表当前逐格编辑UI，commit/cancelSave为空。；显示开关要求Item.displayReadable()；该谓词和目录条目不证明当前飞机支持。拖动或无障碍上/下移按uid持久化顺序；删除立即改Config。；Readouts以enabled rows建立网格，每500ms检查revision、更新值/颜色；无行时隐藏。Presentation将无值/断连显示为破折号，cache或过期/SDK错误等不标current，保留值时显示灰色与年龄。；同item的多行按最短interval同步Monitor采样配置；每行有自己的显示快照节流。
写入或副作用: 本地显示行、顺序、可见性与采样选择/间隔；不是写被显示的飞行参数。
确认: 切换、移动、删除即时保存，无通用撤销；新值须点Add to screen；已有行格式由ValueEditor自动保存。
恢复与生命周期: Config以JSON+revision持久化；Readouts在attach启动500ms更新，detach/dispose移除回调；界面重建从Config恢复。
复用建议: 适合FindUAS：读数与来源/时效分离、结构化字段复用与聚合最短采样间隔；勿把目录可读谓词当实机成功。

功能: 遥测外观、预览和位置恢复
入口: Telemetry → Appearance and preview；FPV上拖动整块遥测
默认设置: columns: 4；effective_font_sp: 16；font_preference_zero: 0解析为16sp；font_bounds: 10；32；column_bounds: 1；10；initial_position: 未存位置时底部居中，避开底部72dp
实现: Appearance提供字体滑块和列数增减，实时使用同一Presentation值预览。；ReadoutGrid按行数与列数自动排版；字符容量默认4，单行max=0时布局按16估计，其余最多64；受父宽度限制时缩小单元宽并ellipsis。；DragHandle存telemetry_block_x_dp/y_dp；布局变化时读回并clamp，拖动过程中不抢位置。
写入或副作用: device-protected mod_settings中的telemetry_font_sp、telemetry_block_columns和block位置；仅显示。
确认: 立即写偏好，无单独Save；拖动CANCEL/第二手指恢复本次起点。
恢复与生命周期: Appearance仅attached时每500ms刷新，移除时取消；Readouts运行时读取字体/列数，位置跨重启。旧telemetry_block_rows被迁移，但当前Readouts.dimensions使用基准1行并自动扩行。
复用建议: 可复用同源预览、dp位置和取消回滚；需把真实文字测量与单位/精度展示做成明确规则，不能把字符上限当数值精度。

功能: ValueEditor编辑显示处理，Read与Request update是另外的动作
入口: Telemetry每行› → ValueEditor.open(existing=true)；Telemetry Browser选item → ValueEditor.open(existing=false)
默认设置: field: Whole value；precision: -1；precision_range: -1原始精度，0–8小数；prefix_postfix_limit_codepoints: 128；trim_range: 0；2048；length_range: 0；2048；interval_ms_range: 500；60000
实现: Form.draft只构造Row：字段路径、倍率、小数位、prefix/postfix、trim、maxCharacters、状态labels、interval；save/add只写Config并Presentation.sync。；可钻取对象字段、JSON、数组/List和多种Map key；路径深度最多16，字段树每页256项。ValueTree通过取值/Field.get读取，没有通用字段写入器。；Formatter按BigDecimal倍率与HALF_UP处理可解析数字/数组，再做状态替换、Unicode codepoint截断、前后缀。长度限制作用于拼好前后缀的最终字符串。；打开可读item时会readOne，Read按钮也读；Advanced只对PushRequests.supported(item)显示Request update，点击直接monitor.requestPush(item)。
写入或副作用: 格式选项是本地配置；interval/selected影响后续读取节奏。Request update是明确例外，会进入真实设备订阅/请求链；父任务已确认其中SNR路径包含SET，不能把整个编辑器宣称绝对只读。
确认: 已有Row改动250ms debounce自动保存，dismiss再次save；新Row仅Add to screen落盘。Request update没有二次确认框（ValueEditor与父任务已闭合Monitor均如此）。
恢复与生命周期: Form每500ms刷新当前值、预览和可选状态；dismiss设closed并清回调。无值/动态字段未出现时保留schema导航但显示缺失原因。
复用建议: 显示转换、字段选择、原始值/处理值并排可复用；应将数据读取、订阅写动作与纯格式编辑明确分开，界面使用准确动词。

功能: 遥测Profile导入、导出、分享及一次撤销
入口: Telemetry → Profile ⋮ → Export / Import / Share / Undo last import
默认设置: format: redfly.telemetry.profile；version: 1；max_input_bytes: 1048576；max_rows: 64；max_favorites: 10000；max_intervals: 10000；nesting_limit: 64；undo_levels: 1
实现: Profile含rows、favorites、intervals、全局interval、monitor、style(font/columns/x/y)；不包含实时读数或所有mod设置。；导出/分享先capture配置快照，通过SAF CREATE_DOCUMENT写UTF-8 JSON；Share写完后发ACTION_SEND chooser，附URI与临时read grant。不会自动选择收件人。；导入经OPEN_DOCUMENT、严格UTF-8、大小/JSON/format/version/类型/范围校验；显示总行数与不可displayReadable的数量，并让用户选Add、Replace或Cancel。；Add保留现有rows并为导入行重生UID，保留现有布局/global settings和已有interval优先；Replace用导入布局/global settings。不可读/未知item行保留但enabled=false。；应用前将当前完整Profile存telemetry_custom44/undo_import；Undo恢复一次并删undo键。
写入或副作用: 本地显示行、favorites、Monitor启用偏好与读取间隔、布局；不是飞机参数备份或固件配置包。导入可改变后续采样行为。
确认: 导入有Add/Replace/Cancel；导出无覆盖之外的应用内二次确认；Undo直接执行。
恢复与生命周期: retained Fragment+后台文件线程，busy防重复；undo持久保存跨重启。应用分多份SharedPreferences.apply，未见跨文件原子事务或中途失败自动回滚。
复用建议: 格式标识、严格边界、未知项禁用和单次Undo适合FindUAS；建议把预览差异与采样变化展示清楚，并以事务化配置提交。

功能: 旧电池浮层保留读取代码，当前由新遥测块接管显示
入口: Q.attach → Bridge.attach → 反射BatteryOverlay.attach；新Telemetry内cells/temperature行是当前用户配置路径
默认设置: legacy_battery_cells_temperature_enabled: True；legacy_position_translation: 0；0；new_rows_enabled: False
实现: BatteryOverlay在连接时订阅FlyModel AircraftBatteryElectricalInfo的cell voltages和temperature；无连接/隐藏/关闭时清订阅。；BatteryReading接受最多16个0.1–6.0范围的有限电压数，温度-60到150，格式为电压列表与°C；这是代码假设的单位/范围，不是实机测值。；position已改为Readouts.battery：有新Readouts时将旧label设GONE并返回true，不把旧字符串转发成新行。Readouts另每500ms压制旧battery/RX tag。；没有新Readouts时BatteryFallback才把旧字符串放在右下相机控件附近；BatteryPlacement旧辅助与addChoice没有当前直接调用证据。
写入或副作用: 旧订阅是读，位置/开关是本地UI偏好；新cells/temperature由Monitor与Row显示配置负责。
确认: 旧addChoice不存在已确认当前菜单入口；不能因legacy默认true说新电池读数默认显示。
恢复与生命周期: 旧run正常/异常收尾均500ms重排（fallback核对）；detach停止回调并取消订阅。新层隐藏旧label本身不等于取消旧订阅。
复用建议: 应合并到一个数据订阅与一个显示模型，避免隐藏旧层后仍做重复工作；电芯数和单位需按数据源显式定义。

功能: RX流量读数是Android网络接收总量差分
入口: Bridge.attach → 反射rxspeed.S.attach；旧浮层通常被Readouts隐藏；当前Telemetry的local:traffic行由父任务已分析的Monitor提供数据
默认设置: legacy_rxspeed_enabled: True；legacy_interval_ms: 1000；legacy_format: KB/s，按1024换算；new_traffic_row_enabled: False；new_traffic_row_multiplier: 8e-06
实现: rxspeed.S.rx遍历/sys/class/net下除lo外接口的statistics/rx_bytes并累加；没有可读值时才试TrafficStats.getTotalRxBytes。；run以elapsedRealtime作差分，首次只建立基线；间隔至少500ms、不超过10秒且计数单调时更新。；新Row默认后缀Mb/s和bytes/s×8e-6；legacy旧显示单位/代码路径与新显示格式应分开。；旧开关commit失败会尝试还原偏好；旧标签位置用rxspeed_tx/ty保存。
写入或副作用: 读系统网络计数并更新TextView，本地开关/位置；无测速请求、无飞机控制。
确认: 无网络测试或服务确认；值不是RSSI、专属视频码率或飞机链路带宽证明，其他接口/进程流量也可计入。
恢复与生命周期: 仍attached且enabled时每1秒调度；detach移除callback和view；新Readouts隐藏旧tag。
复用建议: 可作为设备接收流量的粗指标；FindUAS若需专属链路质量应采集明确接口/流来源并说明单位。

功能: Fly 共存保护是启动时的 root ADB 操作
入口: Manifest provider flycoexist.InitProvider.onCreate runs on process/provider initialization, before the activity-level Startup checks.；The installer-owned fly-coexist.enabled marker is the enabling condition; no marker means immediate return.
默认设置: enabled: off when no marker; installer coexist choice can create marker；marker: app no_backup/fly-coexist.enabled
实现: InitProvider creates a daemon FutureTask, waits up to 4.5s, and calls root().；root() first checks id -u; if needed, it sets ro.boot.dbg_cnt only when empty, requests ADB TCP port5555 and adbd restart, then polls UID0.；The main-app flycoexist.LocalAdb implementation rejects AUTH rather than supporting the outer installer RSA exchange.；With root confirmed it requests force-stop of stock dji.go.v5 and dji.redfly and requires its success marker.
写入或副作用: ProcessBuilder getprop/setprop in app identity; TCP 127.0.0.1:5555; ADB shell am force-stop.；Writes no_backup/fly-coexist.jsonl, rotated to fly-coexist.previous.jsonl beyond1MiB.
确认: A successful ADB command marker is recorded. Failure cancels the future, logs startup_blocked and throws IllegalStateException from ContentProvider.onCreate, potentially preventing launch.
恢复与生命周期: Marker survives launches until removed by installer mode changes or app data removal.；This provider has no baseline/restore of prior running apps, ADB properties or root state. Stopped apps may later be launched normally.
复用建议: Clarifies the process-conflict prerequisite and why a supposedly ordinary app launch may touch ADB or fail before UI appears.

功能: 自动启动拦截可达，但当前界面的开关入口未完全闭合
入口: PureLaunchActivity AndroidAOP onCreate calls Startup.stopSystemLaunch; DJIDeviceActivity AndroidAOP onCreate calls Startup.stopMainPage; onNewIntent calls noteIntent.；Manual launcher, external VIEW and USB accessory launches can mark the task as manual.
默认设置: key: redfly_auto_start；default: True；runtime_store: current package device-protected mod_settings；legacy_migration: copy normal-storage value only while the device-protected key is absent
实现: Disabled non-manual HOME/system launcher candidates are hidden; code tries another enabled/exported HOME except FallbackHome.；If no launcher is available it retries once a second, up to30 attempts, then finishes the task.；finishSilently removes the task and after300ms kills its own process only when the static manual-task set is empty.；S.tabAdvanced contains a legacy autostart switch using normal mod_settings; Extras.addStartup contains a device-protected switch via Startup.preferences. The whole-DEX reference index found no direct incoming call to either S.tabAdvanced or Extras.addStartup, and current Menu.page does not call them.
写入或副作用: Activity/task visibility and self-process kill; local device-protected files/redfly-startup.log with approximately64KiB rollover behavior.；No network operation in Startup.
确认: The actual startup decision is controlled by the device-protected preference, defaulttrue.；Trace includes timestamps, task IDs, caller/intent text and decisions; it is a local plain-text log.
恢复与生命周期: Preference persists across process restarts.；Current user-reachable autostart control remains UNKNOWN; a functioning builder method alone is not a proved UI route.；Manual launches are preserved by the code classifier, but runtime origin/flag behavior was not tested.
复用建议: Useful separation of system-triggered entry and operator entry, plus evidence that initialization and foreground visibility are separate events.

功能: Quiet startup 是固定的布尔读取覆盖
入口: PersistenceStorage.f(key), g(key,default) and h(namespace,key) call quietstart.Flags.value before the original MMKV read.
默认设置: first_start_flag: False；forced_true_keys: key_newbie_guide_fly_practice；key_newbie_guide_no_gps_has_shown；key_has_shown_app_display_choose_dialog；key_has_shown_display_mode_bubble；key_newbie_bubble_guide_camera_mode_shown；key_newbie_bubble_guide_camera_osd_shown；key_newbie_bubble_guide_flight_mode_shown；KEY_GUIDE_ASSISTANT_LIVE_SHOW；KEY_GUIDE_DRAG_ASSISTANT_LIVE_SHOW；KEY_GUIDE_BEACON_BUBBLE_SHOW；KEY_GUIDE_BEACON_CONTROL_RIGHT_BUBBLE_SHOW；FLIGHT_OSD_WIND_SPEED_GUIDE_NEVER_SHOW；key_has_shown_portrait_newbie_guide；key_handheld_direction_track_new_guide_has_complete；key_no_more_portrait_safety_guide；unmatched: -1 delegates to original read；UI_toggle_found: False

写入或副作用: In-process preference-read interception; this hook does not rewrite the stored flag values.
确认: Selected onboarding/guide callers receive forced completed/suppressed states.
恢复与生命周期: Behavior is baked into code on every matching read; no independent on/off or restore operation is present.
复用建议: Shows exactly which guide states are suppressed and avoids interpreting a broad Startup quiet label as a global launch policy.

功能: 应用更新开关只拦自动检查
入口: Current modsettings160.Menu.page(0) adds updatecontrols.Entry; its row writes Policy.APP.；AppUpgradeChecker.L(boolean isAutoCheck) is the original-class hook.
默认设置: preference: mod_settings/auto_check_app_updates；default: True；context_unavailable_default: True
实现: When isAutoCheck is true and Policy.app is false, returns Single.just(AppUpgradeInfo.empty) before normal work.；A false isAutoCheck argument still enters the original path.
写入或副作用: No new update endpoint; this is an early return before the existing update machinery.
确认: Suppresses the patched automatic-check entry, while manual checking remains available.

复用建议: A precise app-level network gate that can be cleanly modeled independently.

功能: 固件开关阻止选定在线检查，保留本地 Image 路线
入口: Menu general-page firmware row; hooks in legacy and newer UpdateChecker implementations.
默认设置: preference: mod_settings/check_firmware_updates；default: True
实现: Legacy com.uav.service.firmwareupgrade.UpdateChecker.e0(Image,boolean): null Image + disabled returns error Single; a non-null Image still goes to c1.；Legacy i0() rejects when disabled.；New uav.services.firmwareupgrade.impl.UpdateChecker.N(Image,boolean) and R() provide equivalent checks, retaining B0(Image) for non-null Image.；Policy.blocked produces a localized IOException.
写入或副作用: Early error at app-side checker entry; no system OTA package deletion, partition patch or protection file change.
确认: Automatic and manual online checks through these entries are blocked when off; caller receives an error.
恢复与生命周期: Preference survives restart and can be re-enabled. Existing in-flight checks/downloads are not explicitly canceled.
复用建议: Useful boundary between online firmware metadata/checking and local update artifacts.

功能: FlySafe 开关控制新下载，不删除禁飞区或已有数据库
入口: Menu general-page FlySafe row; hooks in two background upgrade managers, Java download adapters and a JNI download wrapper.
默认设置: preference: mod_settings/download_flysafe_database；default: True
实现: FlightRestrictClient.b returns an error Single when off. UAVDataUpgradeServerAdapter.e invokes failure callback(-1) and returnsnull.；Both DbUpgradeImplManager background callbacks return Unit before starting work.；JNIFSCEDbUpgradeHelper.startDownloadCEDatabase skips native_StartDownloadCEDatabase and calls onFailure(-1) when off.；Separate startImportDynamicDb and aircraft/app database-upgrade wrappers are not gated by that download wrapper.
写入或副作用: App-side network/download dispatch suppression only.
确认: Blocks new requests through selected paths, including manually triggered download calls; existing database files are retained.
恢复与生命周期: Re-enable preference for later downloads. No database restore is needed because this code does not remove them; an existing operation may finish.
复用建议: Identifies a narrow download policy and avoids confusing database transport with aircraft restriction control.

功能: 录屏启动延迟确有原类 hook，但 v6 存在配置路径不一致
入口: AppPerformanceMonitor$startScreenRecordForidTimerTask$1.invokeSuspend calls screenrecguard.G.enabled() without Context at caller code-unit0x21.；Current Menu.page advanced diagnostics uses normalSwitch to write the current Context mod_settings preference.
默认设置: key: screen_record_startup_guard；default: True；hook_read_path: /data/user_de/0/dji.go.v5/shared_prefs/mod_settings.xml；read_failure_default: True
实现: If enabled() is true, the coroutine requests low-performance state through PerformanceLevelConfig.R(true,...), waits60s, then calls R(false,...).；G.enabled() reads the hard-coded XML as text and looks for a literal false entry; missing/unreadable file returns true.；The Context overload reads current-context preferences, but the sole discovered host hook calls the no-Context overload.
写入或副作用: Local preference-file read; normal performance-state calls, not direct recording control.
确认: The startup timer can skip its initial low-performance assertion if the exact hook read returnsfalse.；STATIC mismatch: switching the current v6 UI setting alone is not evidence that the v5 path used by the hook changes.
恢复与生命周期: UI value persists in current package preferences; hook result remains dependent on the separate v5 file.；No runtime test of toggle effect or low-resource behavior was performed.
复用建议: A concrete defect/compatibility question to avoid carrying into a reimplementation.

功能: 诊断日志默认不加密；开关覆盖七个原类调用点
入口: Current Menu advanced diagnostics flightSwitch(enc) -> S.setEncLogs; original crypto wrappers call S.encLogs at entry.
默认设置: key: mod_settings/enc_logs；default: False；in_process_cache: sEnc initially-1; setter updates both cache and preference
实现: Seven hooks across five classes: uav.log.impl.SimpleEncryption.encrypt(String), uav.midware.sdr.log.CommonLogEncryption.encrypt(String/byte[]), lct.log.impl.SimpleEncryption.encrypt(String), lcti.log.impl.SimpleEncryption.encrypt/decrypt(String), uav.core.log.crypto.LogCrypto.a(String).；Off returns the input unchanged. Four Java encryption classes retain their original AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding routes when on and properly initialized. LogCrypto retains its existing PBKDF2/AES wrapper.；lcti decrypt also returns its input when the setting is off; this is not a bulk conversion of existing encrypted files.
写入或副作用: Changes payloads passed through selected app file-log crypto functions; no server call and no file rewrite by the switch itself.
确认: New log entries using these wrappers may become plain text by default.；Probe42 JSONL, Startup trace, flycoexist JSONL and apptelemetry state files are direct file writes and are not covered by these seven hooks.；FlightRecord decryption and SandPlain native logging are separate features.
恢复与生命周期: Preference persists; setter affects future wrapper calls immediately through sEnc. Turningon does not retroactively encrypt plaintext files; turningoff does not decode old ciphertext.
复用建议: Useful for understanding which local evidence may be readable and which logger owns a file.

功能: 无登录功能通过合成账户 UUID 与诊断抑制实现
入口: uav.services.activate.impl.WriteUuidLogic.N is annotated ON_APP_START and starts account, FC, GLS, Beacon and guest-gate subscriptions.；q0 combines aircraft connection and fake-UUID-support observable emissions; s0 then reads the current login subject.
默认设置: UI_toggle_found: False；behavior: automatic when its subscription emits a connected state while the cached login state is false；fixed_identifier: one19-digit synthetic probe value, intentionally redacted
实现: s0 pushes the redacted fixed synthetic value to the uid BehaviorSubject when connected and not logged in.；Z/a0/b0 carries nonempty uid values into FlyModel.y().getFlightDeviceInfo().getFcuuidSettingInfo().h(value).；The same uid subject also feeds Beacon UUID and GLS setUuid paths when their connection conditions hold.；The newer WriteUuidLogic.Y diagnostic branch returns a zero diagnostic in both login branches; legacy com.uav.component.bglogic.WriteUuidLogic.v likewise returns0 in both branches.；Real account login callbacks can replace the subject with the account UID; this does not constitute a saved-baseline restore.
写入或副作用: An app-side value is submitted to existing SDK setters and diagnostics streams; callback/result logging remains.；This is not only hiding an informational UI label, because the UUID setter path remains reachable.
确认: Exact static mechanism for the claimed no-login feature is closed through Java setter dispatch.；The synthetic value is an app/account UUID input in this chain; it must not be relabeled Remote ID Operator ID, Basic/UAS ID or an aircraft RF identity.
恢复与生命周期: No UI off switch, captured FC baseline, explicit prior-UUID restore, persistence check or independent flight-limit readback was found.；Actual device acceptance and persistence are unknown.
复用建议: Separates account/login restriction diagnostics and UUID state from broadcast RID; identifies concrete owner/key paths worth observing before any proposed state change.

功能: Probe42 是无开关的本地后台采样器
入口: PureLaunchActivity calls Probe.init after the startup-stop check; instrumented WriteUuidLogic logging also calls Probe.c13/c20/gate/state.；Probe.event starts one daemon thread per process.
默认设置: UI_toggle_found: False；snapshot_interval_ms: 2000；event_queue_capacity: 256；file_rotation_bytes: 4194304；retained_older_files: 3
实现: Dequeues tagged events, tracks dropped-event counts and periodically reads cached connection/login/UUID category, height-distance limits/reasons, GPS quality/satellite count, motor/flying status and distance-to-home values.；UUID cache value is categorized as empty/probe/other-length; event scrub replaces the known probe literal and16–20 digit runs. This is a bounded redaction rule, not a general privacy proof.
写入或副作用: Logcat plus app external-files/probe42/nologin.jsonl with internal-files fallback; files are direct UTF-8 JSONL.；No network/API call exists in this logger class.
确认: Local diagnostic time series can continue after leaving the launcher UI while the process lives.；It records cache observations rather than verified device GET replies or RF evidence.
恢复与生命周期: Log files survive process restart and are rotated; no UI erase/stop switch in Probe. Encryption toggle does not wrap these direct writes.
复用建议: Useful example of cache-age, event and diagnostic separation, but its data should be handled as private local evidence.

功能: 启动诊断默认开启，并有真实的 HTTPS 外发链
入口: Manifest non-exported apptelemetry.InitProvider.onCreate calls LaunchTelemetry.start.；start limits itself to the app main process and registers ActivityLifecycleCallbacks; a worker thread loads state and registers a network callback.；Current Menu.page(0) adds apptelemetry.Entry, whose switch calls setEnabled.
默认设置: preference: redfly_launch_telemetry_settings/enabled；default: True；explicit_initial_consent_gate_in_this_path: False
实现: runOnce builds a JSON payload, posts a SHA-256 payload digest to /challenge, solves the supplied bounded proof, then posts Base64URL payload plus challenge/counter to /launch.；A true accepted response updates persistent success state. The endpoint is https://redfly.app/api/app/v1/.
写入或副作用: Actual HttpsURLConnection POST/write/getResponseCode calls are reachable from provider -> lifecycle -> scheduler -> runOnce -> post.；No endpoint was accessed by this analysis.
确认: payload_fields: product；package_name；version_name；build_number；signer_sha256[]；event_id；installation_id；drone；controller；event_id: random16-byte hex per event；installation_id: random16-byte hex saved persistently in no_backup/redfly-launch-telemetry/installation-id；drone_controller: connected model enum + firmware_version; hardware_version always JSON null; unconnected/unknown model becomes null；not_built_by_this_payload: coordinates；device serial numbers；account UID/email/token；flight logs
恢复与生命周期: A random persistent installation ID links reports from the same app-data installation. Turningoff does not delete this ID or request server deletion.；Pending event payload and rate state are stored as unencrypted AtomicFile JSON under app no_backup/redfly-launch-telemetry/state.json.
复用建议: Identifies the mod author service, exact data contract and actual automatic trigger; avoids mistaking a webpage privacy sentence for the implementation.

功能: 诊断限频、退出和加密边界是客户端逻辑
入口: TelemetryPolicy is loaded/persisted by the main-process worker; foreground/network events schedule ticks.；setEnabled(false) updates preference, requests active-connection disconnect and schedules pending-state cancellation.
默认设置: client_success_interval_ms: 86400000；maximum_attempts_per_event: 4；backoff_minutes: 2；8；32；128；per_attempt_jitter_ms: 0..60000；proof_difficulty_bits: 16..22；proof_budget: <=262144 counters and about3s；http: 4s connect/read,10s disconnect watchdog, redirects disabled
实现: Retries reuse a pending event payload; response caps are4096 bytes and payload is capped at2048 bytes.；HTTP429/503 can extend Retry-After; most other3xx/4xx except408/409 stop that event.；Fallback decompilation confirms retry scheduling uses nextAttempt while unfinished with attempts<4; completed/exhausted events use max(newEventAt,nextAttempt).；The challenge uses SHA-256 work and Base64URL encoding; neither is payload encryption. This module uses HTTPS and does not install a custom TrustManager/HostnameVerifier or field-level encryption.
写入或副作用: Up to4 event attempts can involve separate challenge and launch HTTP requests; this is not a cap of4 total HTTP requests.；On pause/stop only lifecycle counters are changed. An already-started HTTP operation may finish; disabling also asks for disconnect but is not a proof that prior bytes were unsent.
确认: At most one client-acknowledged successful event per24h is enforced from retained state.；HTTP transport protection is TLS subject to the app/platform TLS configuration; no end-to-end or at-rest encryption is established.
恢复与生命周期: Toggleoff clears pending payload/state.finished and prevents future allowed attempts; toggleon can schedule again while honoring retained time limits.；Persistent ID, successful timestamps and remote data are not rolled back by the switch.
复用建议: Provides a reusable conceptual separation between local scheduling state, in-flight cancellation and server acknowledgement.

功能: UTMiSS opt-out 是隐私授权与应用上传服务的门禁
入口: Existing privacy settings VM.setUtmissReportEnableState writes PrivacyType.UTMISS_REPORT through IPrivacyService.p4.；UtmissReportView close button writes false; open/open-once write true, with a separate toast/once flag.；UtmissReportBackgroundLogic.s loads privacy state and listens for changes; r combines that state with service connection eligibility.
默认设置: privacy_read: IPrivacyService.t4(UTMISS_REPORT,false)；service_feature_flag: is_pm_need_utmiss_feature；feature_flag_default: True；upload_started_state_default: False；effective_fresh_privacy_value: delegated to the actual IPrivacyService/storage; only the false fallback argument is directly closed here
实现: k returns immediately when the privacy service is absent or does not authorize UTMISS_REPORT.；If permitted, k calls UAVUtmissManager.startUtmissUpload(path), which calls JNIUtmiss.native_InitUtmissUpload; success sets started state, resets a UASId input and registers observers.；Background callback p invokes stop service when combined eligibility becomesfalse; f calls native_UninitUtmissUpload and clears local started/status state.；This is not unconditional disabling: the permitted upload route is still present.
写入或副作用: App privacy-state writes and start/stop calls into the existing native UTMiSS uploader.；No telemetry endpoint or actual uploaded field set was established from this Java boundary.
确认: Confirms a real application-side opt-out gate and lifecycle stop operation, separate from the RedFly launch-diagnostics feature.
恢复与生命周期: The privacy setting persists through its privacy service; re-enabling permits a later eligible start.；No native-quiescence, persisted aircraft change or baseline/restore proof follows from stop returning.
复用建议: Useful separation of China/app reporting policy from broadcast RID, Operator ID and aircraft firmware behavior.

功能: SandPlain：原生 _sand 日志保留记录头、正文为明文
入口: Java UAVSDKManager initialization -> JNISdk native_initialize -> JNI_SDKInitialize -> uav::sdk::initialize -> ModuleMediator::InitializeLog -> uav::base::InitializeUAVLog -> Logger::Initialize
默认设置: Fixed code path in the supplied native library; no corresponding per-record Java enc_logs preference test is present in the inspected formatter/writer
实现: libsdk_base.so Logger::BuildFileName builds a dated _sand filename with a counter and .log suffix. The function still named plog::EncryptFormatter::format invokes TxtFormatter::format, zero-initializes a buffer, adds an 8-byte record header including magic/length, and copies the text unchanged. UavLogAppender::write queues that formatted buffer; its worker directly writes the buffer to the file descriptor. The inspected normal data path contains no encryption operation.
写入或副作用: App diagnostic log file output; no aircraft state write or firmware decryption
确认: Native pseudocode, instruction body and direct-call/PLT bindings were inspected offline. No APK execution or generated _sand file was observed, and no claim is made that every app/native log family is plaintext.
恢复与生命周期: InitializeUAVLog uses a mutex and once-initialized flag. Re-enabling Java enc_logs cannot be assumed to restore encryption of this independent native path; a different native build would be required unless an uninspected external logger selection changes the route.
复用建议: Useful for a bounded local diagnostic collector/parser and identifying log owner/format. It neither decrypts historical encrypted _sand records nor unlocks DAT/firmware. Adopt our own source-built logger and data redaction, not the vendor formatter implementation.

功能: Enhanced Transmission 的地区与展示判断有三处固定允许
入口: Existing LTE service/UI callers use LteService.Z0() for aircraft display eligibility, w2() for controller display eligibility, and q3() for feature-country eligibility.；FlightOSDTopSignalWithPopViewModel.z1 calls ILteService.Z0; DeviceListDetailViewModel.getAccessoriesVisibilityObservable combines Z0/w2 with actual aircraft/controller connection and selected aircraft serial matching.
默认设置: Z0: True；w2: True；q3: True；effective_default: Hardcoded return at method entry; no preference or user switch surrounds these returns.；separate_visibility_force: h2 starts false; X4 can set it, but the 32-DEX direct-reference scan found no incoming X4 call. force_show_lte_switch_boolean is read with false default and developer-state condition; no writer was found in that scan.
实现: Raw DEX confirms Z0/w2/q3 each begin an unconditional true return. The retained code after the return is unreachable.；Unreachable Z0/w2 code inspects DongleBaseInfo.isSupportDisplayControl and DEFAULT_SUPPORT_DISPLAY, otherwise falls back to q3.；Unreachable q3 code reads Y1==TRUE. Y1 is otherwise populated from the local unsupported-country list in M2 and cloud lte_feature_not_support_country_code in E5. The parallel binding-country subject Z1 remains separate.；This closes a regional/display implementation distinct from the mod-specific Auto LTE HYBRID attempt (radio-003) and APN shortcut/editor guards (radio-004).
写入或副作用: The forced methods only return booleans. Existing regional cloud configuration retrieval is still present; no request was made during this analysis.
确认: Static result: the service answers allowed/displayable regardless of the retained checks in these three methods. UI service absence, connection conditions and further checks can still suppress or reject an operation.
恢复与生命周期: The return values are embedded in this APK; they do not write a device region, firmware, SIM or subscription state.；No runtime restore switch for these forced bodies was identified. Selecting SDR turns off the requested link mode but does not restore the replaced region/display decisions.
复用建议: Useful for distinguishing app presentation policy, app eligibility and actual radio/device state when designing diagnostics.

功能: LTE 启用流程跳过两项地区拒绝，保留其余条件并实际提交 HYBRID
入口: A user change of the Enhanced Transmission switch enters SettingLinkModeLteViewGate.M; enabling calls Q, which consults ILteService.k5().；LteService.k5 first checks e3() for aircraft-area rejection (reason 32), then Z2() for controller-area rejection (reason 33). Both bodies are forced false in this artifact.
默认设置: e3: False；Z2: False；bypass_default: Always active in the current method bodies, independent of the Auto LTE preference.；link_mode_default: Not established as HYBRID by these changes. The view observes current GroundWLMLiveService.mode and derives checked state from LteService.f2().；last_enabled_preference: KEY_LTE_LAST_TIME_ENABLE_STATE is written by i5 after the mode-request success callback; it is not a region-bypass toggle.
实现: Raw DEX confirms e3 and Z2 each begin an unconditional false return. This makes k5 reasons 32/33 unreachable through those branches.；The retained unreachable implementations test aircraft/controller dongle AREA_NOT_SUPPORT, cloud feature-country status and an eSIM-specific country condition. Normal JADX failed on these altered control-flow bodies; fallback output and raw instructions agree.；After the remaining k5 checks succeed and binding information is available, the view sends HYBRID via FlyModel.getGroundAirlink().getGroundWLM().getGroundWLMLiveService().getMode().j(mode). The off path requests SDR.；The request has success/error callbacks; success writes the last-enabled preference and logs success. The callback does not itself inspect FlyResult fields. Separately, X() observes the live mode and the gate updates the switch from current LteService.f2().
写入或副作用: Issues a FlyModel link-mode request rather than merely showing a switch or writing a preference. No request was executed by this review.；Existing binding, privacy and service checks may require network responses; their outcomes were not tested.
确认: Static closure of the advertised forced LTE activation at the app-region rejection boundary, plus a real HYBRID setter path. This is narrower than guaranteed cellular connectivity.；The mode observer is an app-visible confirmation route, but no live readback, network traffic or aircraft acceptance was collected.
恢复与生命周期: The ordinary off path requests SDR and, on its success callback, stores last-enabled=false. It refuses to close LTE while SDR is lost, and can show a weak-SDR confirmation dialog.；The region rejection bypass remains embedded after switching SDR. No device-region backup/rollback or restore for these method changes is present in the inspected path.
复用建议: Provides a concrete distinction between removing an app-side rejection, submitting a device mode command, and confirming actual link operation.

功能: Developer Mode Tools 菜单可达，显示两类不同来源的 UUID，并有复制和手动扫码上报
入口: UAVSettingsFragment.initView binds account_center_settings_developer_mode_tools_layout, associates it with a supplier for DeveloperModeToolsFragment, and initListeners installs the click handler; handleLeftDrawableLayouts/showFragment replaces the child fragment.；initListeners subscribes to IAppStateService.U4 (developerModeSwitchObservable). Its lambda29 discards the incoming boolean and executes an unconditional true branch that sets this tools menu visible.
默认设置: menu: Visible after the developer-mode observable emits, regardless of its boolean value; this is the Tools menu, separate from UAVDeveloperSettingsFragment.；phone_uuid: DefaultAppStateService.y reads key_uuid with empty fallback; init generates UUID.randomUUID().toString only if empty and persists it.；aircraft_fcuid: UAVProductKey.G / KeyProductUUID; empty default hides the FCUID row, nonempty values show it.；upload: Triggered by a manual scan result accepted by the configured suffix check; opening the page only displays values and registers handlers.
实现: Phone text reads IAppStateService.y directly. DefaultAppStateService stores key_uuid through PersistenceStorage; this value is separate from the account-related synthetic FCUUIDSetting examined in system-009.；Aircraft text uses RxCSDK.h1(KeyProductUUID,empty). The chain reaches RxCSDK__RxCSDKKt.W, which reads Request.GetValue through RxCSDK.O/N, installs Request.Listen, and publishes the current/new value. This fragment does not issue Request.Get to force a new hardware transaction.；The two copy buttons read their displayed text and call ClipboardManager.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText). No UUID editor or aircraft UUID write was found in this fragment.；The Scan button requests QR_CODE scanning. Its result parses URI authority and checks case-sensitive endsWith against .dbeta.me, .djicorp.com and .djigate.com from DJIApplicationConfigs.v; fallback confirms a matching suffix reaches the accepted branch.；An accepted scan result calls postScanUrl with the scanned URL. JSON fields are drone from IDeviceBaseService.D4(), mbrand from Build.BRAND, mmodel from Build.MODEL and sn from IDeviceBaseService.d1(). Headers include X-Device-Id from the app Phone UUID, request ID, app/version/platform metadata and Android release. The oddly named code_uuid header also receives Android release, not the displayed FCUID.；The request callback parses the response model and reports completion/error to the UI. No actual endpoint response or identifier values were accessed in this analysis.
写入或副作用: Manual clipboard writes for either displayed value.；Manual accepted QR scan sends an HTTP request to its scanned URL; there is no single hardcoded submission URL in the fragment and no automatic submission merely from opening this page.
确认: The website claim about displaying Phone UUID/Aircraft FCUID has a reachable implementation. It also exposes copy and QR-assisted diagnostic reporting actions.；The two UI labels refer to different identity sources: locally generated app state versus SDK product identity. Neither should be conflated with broadcast Remote ID or an operator/UAS identifier.
恢复与生命周期: Phone UUID persists in the app storage and is reused until absent; no reset control was identified here.；The aircraft display/listener and clipboard action do not write the SDK product UUID. The subscriptions are registered in the fragment composite-disposable collection.；Clipboard contents and a completed remote submission are not rolled back by closing the page.
复用建议: Useful read-only diagnostic UI pattern and identity taxonomy: app-install UUID, product UUID and account/operator identifiers must remain distinct.
